chunks: Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Fadl al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Jafar known as Ibn al-Tibban narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Khalid al-Muqri al-Kisai narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Dahir al-Razi narrated to us from his father from Sad b. Turayf from al-Asbagh b. Nubata. He said: One day, we were gathered around Amir al-Muminin, peace be upon him, in the Mosque of Kufa, when he said:

O people of Kufa! Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has loved you in a way that He has not loved anyone else, so He uplifted your place of prayer. It is the house of Adam, the house of Nuh, the house of Idris, the place of prayer of Ibrahim the Friend, the place of prayer of my brother al-Khidr, peace be upon him, and my place of prayer. This mosque of yours is one of the four mosques that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has chosen for its people. It is as if I see it on the Day of Resurrection wearing two white garments, resembling one in ihram, interceding for its people and for whoever prayed in it, and its intercession will not be rejected. The days will not pass until the Black Stone is placed in it. There will surely come a time when it will be the place of prayer of the Mahdi from my progeny, and the place of prayer of every believer, and there will not remain a believer on Earth except that he has been in it or his heart has yearned for it. So do not forsake it, and come closer to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, by praying in it. Desire to come to it for the fulfillment of your needs. For if the people knew the blessing that is in it, they would come to it from every region of the Earth, even if they had to crawl on ice.

key_terms.الحجر الأسود: The Black Stone — the sacred stone in the Kaaba, prophesied here to be relocated to Kufa's mosque
key_terms.الخضر: al-Khidr — the enigmatic righteous servant of God mentioned in Quran 18:65-82
key_terms.الخليل: The Friend — title of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), denoting his special closeness to God
key_terms.المهدي: The Mahdi — the awaited messianic figure in Islamic eschatology, specifically from Imam Ali's progeny
key_terms.مسجد الكوفة: Mosque of Kufa — one of the oldest and most sacred mosques in Islam according to Shia tradition

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the virtues and history of the Mosque of Kufa?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam Ali (as) addresses the people of Kufa about the extraordinary spiritual status of their mosque. He traces its sacred history back to the prophets Adam, Nuh, Idris, and Ibrahim, and declares it one of the four divinely chosen mosques. He prophesies its role in the Mahdi's era and urges the Kufans not to abandon it, promising that its intercession on the Day of Judgment will not be rejected. The hyperbolic closing — people crawling on ice to reach it — emphasizes its unparalleled blessings.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Fadl al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ja`far al-Ma`ruf b. al-Tibyan narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Khalid al-Muqri’ al-Kisa’i narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Dahir al-Razi narrated to us from his father from Sa`d b. Turayf from al-Asbagh b. Nubata.  He said: One day, we were gathered around Amir al-Mu’minin in the Mosque of Kufa when he said:

O people of Kufa! Allah has loved you in a way that He has not loved anyone else, so He uplifted your place of prayer, which is the house of Adam, the house of Nuh, the house of Idris, the place of prayer for Ibrahim the Friend and my brother al-Khidr (as), and my place of prayer. This mosque of yours is one of the four mosques that Allah has chosen for its people. It is as if I am in it on the Day of Resurrection, wearing two white garments, giving intercession to its people and to whomever prayed in it. Its intercession is not rejected. The days will not pass until the Black Stone will be brought to it. There will come a time where it will be the place of prayer of the Mahdi from my progeny, and the place of prayer of every believer, and there will not be a believer on Earth except that he has been in it or craved it in his heart. So, do not forsake it, and come closer to Allah by praying in it. Desire to come to it to fulfill your needs. If the people were to know its blessing, they would come to it from every region of the Earth, even if they had to crawl on ice.
